headline: Sensex tumbles 1,450 points from day's high as early gains reverse; IT stocks surge while financials drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking following a sustained four-week market rally
Global sell-off and weak cues from Asian markets
Heavy selling pressure in financial, banking, and metal sectors
Reversal of early morning gains despite initial foreign fund inflows
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 1,450 points from its intraday high, falling below the 25,600 level
The Nifty IT index rose significantly, with major stocks gaining up to 5% due to global trade shifts
L&T secured a large-scale order worth ₹5,000 crore for an AI cluster project in Chennai
Persistent Systems reported a potential data breach involving employee data via a US law firm
summary: Indian markets experienced extreme volatility as the Sensex crashed 1,450 points from its opening highs, driven by profit-taking in financials and metals. While the broader market declined, IT stocks like TCS and Tech Mahindra surged up to 5% amid global sector tailwinds. L&T provided a bright spot with a major ₹5,000 crore order win, contrasting with a sharp 1% drop in defense stocks.
